tabs.tab_title: What exactly does the FirstSearch Guarantee cover?
tabs.tab_content: [Plain-English summary of the guarantee: what’s guaranteed, how it’s measured, and what happens if it’s missed.]

Real marketing compounds. SEO, brand recognition, reviews and automation take time to build momentum, and the first months lay the foundation for everything after. Six months is enough time to show real, measurable results, and short enough that you’re never locked in for years.

tabs.tab_title: How much does a partnership cost?
tabs.tab_content: Every partnership is a fixed monthly retainer, so you’ll never get a surprise invoice. Partnerships start at [$X,XXX]/month, and your exact investment is set in your roadmap based on your goals.

tabs.tab_content: We work with established local and service businesses that are ready to invest in long-term growth. [List of core industries.]

tabs.tab_content: [We’re based in Hampton and love working with NH businesses, but we partner with businesses across [region].]

tabs.tab_title: Why do you only work with 25 businesses?
tabs.tab_content: Because quality doesn’t scale infinitely. Capping our partner list means every client gets real strategy and senior attention, not a junior account manager juggling forty accounts.

tabs.tab_title: How will I know if it’s working?
tabs.tab_content: You’ll get monthly reporting in plain English, tied to the numbers that matter: leads, calls, bookings and revenue. No vanity metrics and no black boxes.

tabs.tab_title: Who owns my accounts, website and content?
tabs.tab_content: [You do. Your website, ad accounts, content and data belong to your business, always.]
